import{SQLiteRepository}from'../../src/persistence/sqlite.ts';import{Tracer}from'../../src/index.ts';import{startHeadlessServer}from'../../src/interfaces/headless-server.ts';
const repository=new SQLiteRepository(process.argv[2]),server=await startHeadlessServer(new Tracer(repository),{port:0,provenance:{actor:'concurrent-http-proof',reason:'Disposable real-project copy only'}});process.send({ready:true,origin:server.origin});process.on('disconnect',async()=>{await server.close();repository.close();});
